name: SNO
summary: SNO used heavy water to measure both electron-flavour and total active solar-neutrino fluxes. Comparing the charged- and neutral-current channels demonstrated that solar electron neutrinos transform into other active flavours.
detection_principle: Electron neutrinos break up deuterons through charged-current interactions; all active flavours produce neutrons through neutral-current deuteron breakup. Cherenkov light measures charged particles, while neutron detection used pure heavy water, dissolved salt and helium-3 counters in successive phases.
